datasets.verbatim: The two data sets refereed in the following experiments are acquired using Zeiss RMK TOP-15 aerial survey camera from the flying height of approximately 2400 m in April 2007 and July 2014.

methods.name: Automatic adaptive region extension
methods.summary: The method uses k-means clustering on change magnitude images to generate training samples. It then applies an adaptive region extension algorithm to each pixel of the post-event image, where the label is determined by the nearest distance between the central pixel and the changed or unchanged samples. Finally, a maximum likelihood estimation is used to assign the final label to each pixel based on the counts of labels assigned during the extension process.
methods.source: Lv Zhiyong, Tongfei Liu, Robert Yu Wang, Jón Atli Benediktsson, and Sudipan Saha
methods.verbatim: In this letter, an algorithm based on automatic adaptive region extension using very-high-resolution remote sensing images is developed.

reproducibility_assessment: The landslide inventory and input imagery are not linked or publicly available. The custom code used for the automatic adaptive region extension method is not provided or referenced.
